text_block_list.text:
The season for the summer training camp has arrived.
Inside the bus heading toward the camp facility—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worryin' ya back then, Trainer.
Me ma is totally fine now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I heard that when they sent her favorite melons, she happily wolfed them down. Haha, she sure knows how to make a fuss.
It seems the worries about her mother back home are gone, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This highway is... mighty packed, huh...
There's a whole mess of cars besides our bus...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (If something happens... and I get caught up in it...)
Without thinking... Tamamo Cross grabbed my arm tightly from the side.

A weak Umamusume wouldn't think twice about grabbing onto someone's arm.
But for Tamamo Cross to cling on like this of her own accord...

"There's no way it's nothing.
There is only one thing I can convey..."
choice_data_list: Let's find a way to resolve this over the summer.
Let's find a way to resolve this over the summer.

text_block_list.text:
The accident happening was a coincidence. But resolving it—
we absolutely cannot leave that to chance.
